description: OSRS Grand Exchange item prices from InfluxDB (measurement itemPrice, bucket GEItemPrices). Select an item with the $itemID variable.

list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "GEItemPrices",
  tag: "itemID",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "itemPrice",
  start: -30d,
)
list.label: Item ID
list.name: itemID
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "GEItemPrices",
  tag: "itemID",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "itemPrice",
  start: -30d,
)

title: OSRS GE Prices

panels.title: Avg High / Low Price - item $itemID
panels.description: avgHighPrice and avgLowPrice for the selected item, downsampled to the panel window.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "GEItemPrices")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "itemPrice")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.itemID == "${itemID}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "avgHighPrice" or r._field == "avgLowPrice")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Candlestick - item $itemID
panels.description: avgHighPrice mapped to high, avgLowPrice mapped to low, for the selected item.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "GEItemPrices")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "itemPrice")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.itemID == "${itemID}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "avgHighPrice" or r._field == "avgLowPrice")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "avgHighPrice", "avgLowPrice"])

panels.title: Latest Combined Volume - item $itemID
panels.description: Latest highPriceVolume + lowPriceVolume for the selected item.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "GEItemPrices")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "itemPrice")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.itemID == "${itemID}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "highPriceVolume" or r._field == "lowPriceVolume")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value:
        (if exists r.highPriceVolume then r.highPriceVolume else 0.0) +
        (if exists r.lowPriceVolume then r.lowPriceVolume else 0.0),
  }))
  |> last(column: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
